scope: same-equation 600 m moving-child versus oversized stationary Nimbus reference with inherited v10 thresholds, geometry, aperture, containment movement, receding and quantized trusted states, and confirmed ordinary trusted-improvement relocation

ordinary_trusted_improvement_amendment.eligibility: an ordinary approaching inner-margin breach cannot recover the grid-attainable release margin but a bounded whole-parent-cell translation in the approaching direction strictly improves the axis minimum clearance while every face remains outside relaxation

limitations: All numerical thresholds, geometry, aperture, measurement cadence, movement caps, and v12 quantized trusted-balance rules are inherited from the immutable v10 policy chain.
No comparison metric from the invalid v10 candidate was inspected or used to alter a threshold.
Ordinary trusted-improvement relocation retains two-sample confirmation and requires a strict improvement in the weaker axis clearance while every face remains outside relaxation.

A non-improving shift remains the v12 no-mutation quantized state; any current relaxation-zone entry remains unrecoverable, and ambiguity, topology, parent containment, finite evidence, and shift caps remain fail-closed.
A pass remains a bounded same-equation fixed-aperture comparison and does not enable public moving_nest selection or broaden supported physics/backend combinations.
